title: The unit of the comparison for sheaves of sets is invertible
statement: For a scheme X and its small-site comparison ν [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], the unit G→ν_*ν^*G is an isomorphism for every etale sheaf of Type (u+1)-valued sets; equivalently the unit natural transformation is invertible.

proof.text: Restrict the comparison unit to the dense affine etale subsite. Its component at an affine etale scheme is the Kan-extension unit followed by the sheafification map, both invertible by the affine section formula.
Dense restriction and the inclusion of sheaves into presheaves reflect isomorphisms. Hence each unit component, and then the unit natural transformation, is invertible.
